title: France: Arrêté du 22 février 1990 fixant la liste des substances classées comme stupéfiants (Légifrance consolidation; its data were last updated 23 May 2021, ANSM decisions since 2022 are not incorporated)
license: Official legislative text; only short list entries are quoted

entries.quote: Annexe I: Morphine (y compris les préparations d'opium en renfermant plus de 20 p. 100 exprimé en base anhydre ...)
entries.note: Classified as a narcotic (stupéfiant), Annex I. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule; see French customs guidance on carrying narcotic medicines (original prescription, quantity for the prescribed treatment or 28 days).

Classified as a narcotic (stupéfiant), Annex III. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule; see French customs guidance on carrying narcotic medicines (original prescription, quantity for the prescribed treatment or 28 days).

entries.quote: Annexe III: Amphétamine, à l'exception de la préparation présentée en comprimés et renfermant par comprimé : sulfate d'amphétamine 0,005 g, phénobarbital 0,100 g
entries.note: Classified as a narcotic (stupéfiant), Annex III, except one named tablet preparation. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule; see French customs guidance on carrying narcotic medicines (original prescription, quantity for the prescribed treatment or 28 days).

entries.quote: Annexe IV: Lisdexamphétamine et ses sels
entries.note: Classified as a narcotic (stupéfiant), Annex IV. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule; see French customs guidance on carrying narcotic medicines (original prescription, quantity for the prescribed treatment or 28 days).

entries.quote: Annexe I: Cannabis et résine de cannabis
entries.note: Classified as a narcotic (stupéfiant), Annex I. This list alone does not say whether any personal or medical carriage is allowed; treat as high risk. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule.
